title: Agent Hub
subtitle: Manage multi-CLI instructions and portable assets for Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Grok Build, and Gemini CLI from one workspace.
versionRestoreConfirmText: The selected version will be restored as a new current version; existing content moves to history.

shell.contextUnsupported: This context is unavailable because it cannot be bound to one exact project or owner. Return to this device at user scope.

threePane.emptyBlocks: This slot is empty. Type here to fill it.
threePane.emptyPreview: Preview stays empty until you fill common/adapted/exclusive slots.
threePane.emptyOriginal: No original content was found for this agent. The native source remains read-only.
threePane.slotCommonHint: Shared by all agents. This slot does not depend on the selected agent.
threePane.slotAdaptedHint: Adapted body for the current agent. Use “Adapt to other agents” to append rewritten variants to the others.
threePane.slotExclusiveHint: Exclusive content written only for the current agent.
threePane.dualDirtyDescription: Both the slots and the original file have unsaved edits with different content. Pick which content to write.
threePane.aiReviseDescriptionCommon: Claude will revise the shared slot from your direction and save it to Agent Hub Canonical. Native agent files are not written.
threePane.aiReviseDescriptionExclusive: Only the current agent’s exclusive slot is revised and saved to Canonical. The native file is not written.
threePane.aiReviseDescriptionAdapted: The same direction overwrites adapted slots for every agent (empty slots are generated too), then saves Canonical.
threePane.aiReviseDirectionPlaceholder: e.g. make it shorter, add acceptance criteria, drop outdated model names…
threePane.aiReviseSavedAndLocated: The AI revision was saved to Canonical and the first change is located in the current slot.
threePane.aiReviseSavedOtherAgents: The AI revision was saved to Canonical. The current agent’s slot is unchanged; other adapted slots were updated.
threePane.aiReviseSavedNoChange: The AI result was saved to Canonical, but its content matches the existing slots.
threePane.unsavedDraft: The slots have unsaved changes. Saving updates Agent Hub Canonical only; it does not write agent-native files.
threePane.canonicalDrift: Canonical changed while you were editing. This draft cannot be saved because it could overwrite concurrent work.
threePane.sourceDrift: The agent-native source changed while you were editing. The read-only content may be stale; your slot draft is preserved.
threePane.originalReadOnly: Read-only source. Analyze & split overwrites the three slots and never modifies this file.
threePane.analyzeConfirmDescription: Claude will split the original file into common, adapted, and exclusive parts and overwrite the existing slots. The native file is not modified.
threePane.contextSwitchWarning: This context has unsaved slot edits. The content and request context will not switch until you confirm.
threePane.projectScopeUnsupported: Project-scoped instruction writes are not available on this backend yet; no user-scoped write will be attempted.
threePane.directContextUnsupported: Direct instruction access is limited to user scope on this device or a capable peer. Project scope remains unavailable.
threePane.writeBlocked: The current agent cannot write its native file yet. You can still edit and save the Hub draft.
threePane.writeBlockedTargets: At least one target agent cannot write its native file yet. You can still edit and save the shared Hub draft.

errors.emptySync: Composed preview is empty. Fill the common/adapted/exclusive slots first, then write to the native file.
errors.emptyOriginalAnalyze: The original file is empty, so analyze & split cannot run.
errors.emptyAdaptedAdapt: The current agent’s adapted slot is empty, so adapt-to-others cannot run.
errors.reviseSaveFailed: Claude revised the slot, but saving Canonical failed. Click “Save slots” to retry.

userInstructions.title: User instructions
userInstructions.subtitle: See the files each agent actually reads, then manage them as shared content with small agent-specific extensions.
userInstructions.scanOnlyNotice: The current backend can read these files but cannot write them automatically yet. You can still inspect, copy, and open the actual paths.
userInstructions.targetsDescription: Each card shows one primary state, the effective source, and the next safe action.

summary.empty: No user instructions were found. Inspect each agent's effective source before choosing to manage it.
summary.readyToReview: Existing instructions were found and are not managed by Agent Hub yet. Review their sources first.
summary.configuredHealthy: {{managed}} agents are managed and currently in sync.

editor.title: Unified editor
editor.description: Shared content is projected to managed targets; agent extensions are appended only for that agent.
editor.contentTruncated: The canonical content exceeds the safe read limit, so only part is shown. Preview and writes are disabled to avoid overwriting the complete file.
editor.readOnly: This is read-only discovery mode. You may organize a local draft, but no write plan can be generated or applied until the backend supports automatic management.
editor.tabsAria: Choose the user instruction editor pane

capabilities.automatic: Automatic management is available. Every write starts with a per-target preview.
capabilities.scanOnly: Readable; automatic writes are not available yet.
capabilities.scanBlocked: This target cannot be read or managed safely. Follow the diagnostic details.

setup.title: Set up user instructions
setup.description: Explicitly choose whether Agent Hub manages each agent, leaves it unchanged, or keeps its native fallback. Confirmation starts with a preview.
setup.singleSourceDescription: Promote it to shared instructions, then keep only the agent-specific differences as an extension.
setup.scanOnlyReason: The current backend will not write this target.

plan.title: Confirm per-target changes
plan.description: Review each path, operation, diff, shadow/fallback impact, and activation behavior.
plan.truncated: The preview response was truncated and cannot be confirmed safely. Reduce the content or update the backend and try again.
plan.blocked: This plan contains blocked changes and cannot be applied.
plan.emptyTargetBlocked: This target has only extension content while shared content is empty; creating an empty file was blocked.
plan.diffTruncated: The diff was truncated, so this plan cannot be applied safely.

result.success: Every target was handled as planned.
result.partial: Some targets did not complete. The draft was preserved; review each result before retrying.

errors.contentTruncated: The current content was not read in full, so a write plan cannot be generated.
errors.backendUnavailable: The current backend supports reading user instructions only; automatic writes are unavailable.
errors.previewStale: Files changed after the preview. The draft was preserved; refresh and preview again.
errors.sourceRequired: No existing source is available to manage.
errors.slotVersionCopyEmpty: This history version has no copyable text.
errors.slotVersionRestoreEmpty: This history version has no content to restore.
errors.slotVersionNotFound: The selected history version is no longer available. Refresh the drawer and try again.

danger.description: Deleting the canonical asset affects every target managed by Agent Hub.
danger.warning: This does not execute immediately. Enter the asset name, then review the per-target deletion plan.

adoption.lanPushGateC: Cross-device LAN push is available via the LAN Push dialog on this page.

deleteEverywhere.title: Delete asset everywhere
deleteEverywhere.desc: This appends one canonical tombstone and fans out removals to all present targets. This cannot be undone from the matrix UI.

preview.noCommitDefault: cc-partner will not commit or push the project repository.
preview.bridgeNotice: OpenCode runtime bridge preview for {{path}}. Nothing is written until you confirm enable.

plugin.deletePreviewHint: Only exclusive unreferenced components are tombstoned. Shared or standalone refs remain.

inventory.title: Agent assets
inventory.subtitle: Observed inventory for the selected agent. Actual disk state is the source of truth; discovery creates Hub management automatically.
inventory.storeSubtitle: One local copy of each Skill/Command, listed once. Toggle an agent to attach or detach; detach only removes the symlink. Agents that load another agent's files (such as Grok Build) update when that source agent changes.
inventory.empty: No portable assets match the current filters.
inventory.emptyStore: The store is empty. Migrate a local Skill or Command from Equipped, then enable it for any agent from this list.
inventory.staleBanner: Inventory is stale. Mutations are blocked until a successful refresh.
inventory.searchPlaceholder: Search name, native id, or path
inventory.unmanagedRefreshHint: Not managed yet — refresh to bring this asset under Hub management.
inventory.groupBorrowed: Loaded at runtime from other agents
inventory.emptyRuntimeHint: This agent has no locally installed assets, but runtime still loads assets from other agents.

actionDialog.title: Confirm {{action}}
actionDialog.subtitle: The plan is prepared automatically. Nothing is written until you confirm.
actionDialog.fullSuccess: All selected items succeeded or were skipped.
actionDialog.partial: Some items failed or were blocked. Review the per-item report.
actionDialog.outcomeUnknown: Outcome is unknown. Reconcile before retrying with a new request id.
actionDialog.mutationBlocked: Inventory is stale. Preview and apply are blocked until a successful refresh.
actionDialog.contextChanged: The asset or Agent context changed. Generate a new preview.
actionDialog.borrowedImpactEnable: This asset belongs to {{owner}}; {{current}} only loads it at runtime. Enabling rewrites the owner's on-disk enabled state, and other agents that runtime-load it will see the same change.
actionDialog.borrowedImpactDisable: This asset belongs to {{owner}}; {{current}} only loads it at runtime. Disabling rewrites the owner's on-disk enabled state, and other agents that runtime-load it will see the same change.
actionDialog.borrowedImpactEnablePlugin: This plugin belongs to {{owner}}, but each Agent has its own enable flag. This change only updates {{current}} and does not change {{owner}} or other agents.
actionDialog.borrowedImpactDisablePlugin: This plugin belongs to {{owner}}, but each Agent has its own enable flag. This change only updates {{current}} and does not change {{owner}} or other agents.
actionDialog.borrowedImpactUninstall: This asset belongs to {{owner}}; {{current}} only loads it at runtime. Uninstall removes or rewrites the owner's files, and other agents that load it will lose it.
actionDialog.borrowedImpactDetach: This asset is loaded by {{via}}. Detach removes {{via}}'s store symlink. {{via}} and other agents that read {{via}}'s config (including {{current}}) will unload this asset together. The real store tree stays.
actionDialog.borrowedImpactSharedAgents: The shared ~/.agents directory is read by multiple agents, so this change affects every agent that loads from it.
actionDialog.storeAttachHint: Attach only creates a symlink from this agent's native root to the store. It does not copy a second install.
actionDialog.storeDetachHint: Detach only removes this agent's symlink. The real store tree stays, and other attached agents are unchanged.
actionDialog.storeDetachBorrowedHint: Detach removes the source agent ({{via}}) store symlink. The real store tree stays. {{via}} and other agents that read {{via}}'s config (including {{current}}) will unload this asset together.
actionDialog.storeMigrateHint: Migrate moves the native files into the shared store and leaves a symlink. If the same name already exists with different content, the newer version is kept and the older tree is deleted.
actionDialog.storeDestroyHint: Destroy deletes the shared store tree and clears Claude / Codex attachments. This cannot be undone.
actionDialog.storeStillLoadedVia: After detaching {{current}}, this store asset is still loaded via {{via}}. This action will not rewrite {{via}}.
actionDialog.storePluginUnchanged: Plugins do not use the store. Enable flags still change only the viewing agent's switch.
actionDialog.confirmCurrentVersionHint: Files on disk may have been updated. Confirming records the current files as Hub's consistent baseline and does not rewrite disk.
actionDialog.confirmAllCurrentVersionHint: Records {{count}} drifted assets for this Agent and category as Hub's consistent baseline and does not rewrite disk.
actionDialog.migrateAllToStoreHint: Migrates {{count}} native Skill/Command assets for this Agent and category into the store and leaves a symlink at the original path. If the same name already exists with different content, the newer version is kept and the older tree is deleted.
actionDialog.materializeEscapeLinkHint: Replaces the escape symlink at this Agent's native path with a real copy, keeps the original target, and does not migrate into the store or delete ~/.agents sources.
actionDialog.materializeAllEscapeLinksHint: Replaces {{count}} escape symlinks for this Agent and category with real copies, keeps the original targets, and does not migrate into the store.

portablePull.title: Pull from peer (same agent)
portablePull.hint: Pull into this device for the current agent only. Source peer defaults from the shell device context when set; destination always matches the source agent (no cross-agent target).
portablePull.lanNoAuthRisk: Any device on the reachable network can read, write, and execute. The system does not verify caller identity.
portablePull.staleInventory: Remote inventory is stale. Refresh before preview or apply.
portablePull.loadHint: Confirm the source peer and agent (prefilled from the toolbar context when available), then load remote inventory.
portablePull.noCredentials: No credential-bearing assets in this plan
portablePull.canonicalOnlyHint: Some items import as canonical-only (no local native install).

crossAgent.title: Same-machine cross-agent preview
crossAgent.description: Pick a source agent and destinations to preview common / adapted / exclusive / residual differences. No agent files are written.
crossAgent.pageDescription: Preview how local user-level instructions would adapt to other agents. Full adaptation and writes are not certified yet.
crossAgent.previewOnly: Read-only preview: target agents and local native files will not be modified.
crossAgent.selectiveThreeSlotHint: Selective adapt projects common / adapted / exclusive slots: common goes to all destinations, adapted uses per-agent variants, exclusive stays source-only.
crossAgent.fullModeHint: Full mode builds a plan for the entire source scope. Portable skill/command/mcp/plugin items may be residual/skip until copy is ready; instruction apply reuses the selective path.
crossAgent.fullStubNote: Plan generation uses the deterministic stub runner (Claude headless not wired yet). Instruction items still apply via the shared selective writer.
crossAgent.scopeConfirmLabel: I confirm writing under this scope
crossAgent.scopeConfirmPreviewLabel: I confirm this preview uses local user-level content
crossAgent.projectOptInNeeded: Select a project in the hub shell before project-level adapt. Project must be Hub-enabled (opt-in).
crossAgent.projectOptInHint: Target agents write only if this project is already enabled in Agent Hub. Enable from the project workspace if needed.
crossAgent.claudeBlockStub: Block-level “adapt with Claude” is optional; use Full volume mode for entire-config inventory, or edit markdown here for selective adapt.
crossAgent.contentChars: The preview source contains about {{count}} characters
crossAgent.diffUnavailable: The backend did not return a verifiable diff; this result cannot support a write.
crossAgent.noChanges: The destination is already up to date; there is no diff.
crossAgent.needsAdaptation: Content has CLI-specific terms; some destinations may stay exclusive (source-only) or need manual edits in the three slots.
crossAgent.cannotApply: This target cannot be written safely automatically.

errors.projectBlocked: Project-level cross-agent adapt lacks exact project identity. Return to local user scope.
errors.fullUnavailable: Full cross-agent adaptation is not certified. Only selective read-only preview is available.
errors.applyUnavailable: Cross-agent writes are not certified and no write API will be called.
errors.emptyMarkdown: Source instruction content is empty. Load or paste markdown first.
errors.emptyDestinations: Select at least one destination agent.
errors.sourceInDestinations: Destination agents cannot include the source agent.
errors.scopeUnconfirmed: Confirm the write scope before preview.
errors.projectKeyRequired: Choose a project before project-level adapt.
